scheduled_maintenances.name: Twilio SendGrid Legacy Public IP Deprecation

incident_updates.body:
Scheduled - Twilio SendGrid is deprecating a group of legacy IP addresses previously used to reach SendGrid via API and SMTP API.

Customers using legacy Twilio SendGrid IP addresses instead of official domain names (e.g., sendgrid.com or smtp.sendgrid.net) will be affected and should update their configurations immediately.

Engineering will temporarily disable the legacy IPs during the following maintenance windows prior to full removal:

August 24: 9:00 AM – 10:00 AM PST (Temporary disablement)

August 25: 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM PST (Temporary disablement)

August 27: 9:00 AM – 3:00 PM PST (Temporary disablement)

August 31: 9:00 AM PST (Permanent deprecation)

scheduled_maintenances.name: Interconnection Infrastructure Upgrade (SG1 – Edge2 Switch)

incident_updates.body:
Twilio will perform a scheduled maintenance in our SG1 region during a 3-hour window on 4 September 2026 from 08:00 PDT to 11:00 PDT.

During this maintenance, we will perform a Junos OS software upgrade of the SG1 QFX10K Edge2 Switch in the TNX Production SG1 environment.

During this time, Voice, Interconnect, and Flex customers with SG1 interconnections may experience a brief interconnection service interruption of up to 90 seconds. If possible, customers are advised to redirect traffic away from the TNX SG1 interconnection during the maintenance window to minimize any potential impact. Services are expected to recover automatically once the maintenance activity is complete.

scheduled_maintenances.name: Interconnection Infrastructure Upgrade (IE1)

incident_updates.body:
Twilio will perform scheduled network maintenance in our IE1 region during an 8-hour window from 16 October 2026 at 14:00 PDT to 16 October 2026 at 22:00 PDT.

During this window, customers may experience a brief service interruption of up to 90 seconds affecting the following:

Interconnected Customers: All IE1 interconnected customers will experience a brief interconnection service interruption of up to 90 seconds. During this maintenance, the following Twilio services may be impacted if they are using the IE1 interconnection:SIP Interface,Elastic SIP Trunking,WebRTC Client,SMS,Voice and Verify.

Customers interconnected with Twilio exclusively via IE1 will have no workaround during the brief 90-second interruption. Customers configured for failover to DE1 or alternate regions should experience no service disruption, provided automatic failover is enabled on their end.
